run_train_rule_learning: run the training script to learn rules from datasets using GPT or Gemini models
run_train_clutrr_dataset: run the training script with the CLUTRR dataset for rule learning
run_train_arithmetic_dataset: run the training script with an arithmetic dataset specified by base number

run_train_with_prompt_library: run the training script using a YAML prompt configuration and rule library
